The 'gave' (edōken) refers both to the Incarnation (the eternal Son's mission into flesh) and to the cross (the giving up to death) — the two are one redemptive movement. Cyril notes that 'the world' (kosmos) here means the whole of humanity, not the elect-narrowly — universal scope of love, particular efficacy of salvation through faith.
